status: PROPOSAL - patterns taken from the hits of 94 public PDFs (A-414 scan, 2 report templates); other templates, other languages and image-only text are NOT EVALUATED

patterns.name: records_not_printed
patterns.unit: N = number of table records (rows) the source report says it did not print
patterns.status: observed (form 'N records not printed' / '1 record not printed', left of a table title)

patterns.name: n_not_shown
patterns.unit: N = number of entries the source report says it did not show (parenthesised form on a table title line)
patterns.status: observed (form '(N not shown)' beside the title 'Surveys')

probes.unit: case-insensitive phrases counted per page by the scan script to look for variants of the annotation; a probe hit that no pattern matches is a candidate variant to read, never an annotation

line_tolerance_ratio.unit: fraction of the median word height; words whose vertical centres differ by less belong to one line

segment_gap_em.unit: em (word height); a horizontal gap wider than this splits a line into separate segments (title, annotation, header cell)

max_context_words.unit: words allowed in the segment besides the matched annotation (a title such as 'Operations Summary'); longer segments are prose and are rejected

title_line_overlap.unit: fraction of the annotation height that a title segment must share vertically to count as on the same line

title_max_gap_pt.unit: pt; a title segment above the annotation farther away than this is not its title

table_max_gap_pt.unit: pt; a table part must start within this distance below the annotation (or contain it)

table_slack_pt.unit: pt added around a table part box when testing whether it contains or follows the annotation

max_listed_hits.unit: annotation hits copied into one scan summary list
